body.text: The submitted name matches the name on five state registrations, so the applicant resolves onto real filings rather than onto a single unconfirmed one.
Two of those five are active. What the remaining three are is not established here.
The formation state publishes no good-standing sub-status, so the standing of the domestic filing is not something this record can carry either way.

gaps.point: Whether the domestic registration is in good standing
gaps.wouldAnswer: Delaware publishes no good-standing sub-status, so no order returns one. A Certificate of Good Standing from the customer is the only route.
